english: Two men took the parcel off the plane and carried it into the Customs House.
text: off the plane 与 into the Customs House 连出包裹的移动路径：离开飞机，进入海关。讲搬运物品时，可用 off、into 等具体方向配合动作，而不把所有中文“从、到”都机械写成 from、to。
